title: Supply air temperature drifting high
description: Supply air reads 3 degrees C above setpoint during afternoon peak. Check coil and damper actuator.

title: Compressor tripping on overload
description: Unit tripped twice this morning. Production air pressure dropping below 6 bar.

title: Door close sensor intermittently sticky
description: Operators report the car door hesitates before closing on the ground floor.

title: Mechanical seal weeping
description: Small drip observed at the pump seal. Drip tray placed; monitor and plan replacement.

title: Battery string self-test warning
description: UPS self-test flagged string 2 internal resistance above threshold.

title: Coolant concentration out of range
description: Refractometer reading 4 percent against a 7 percent target. Top up and check for contamination.

title: Quarterly filter replacement
description: Planned replacement of G4 pre-filters and F7 bag filters.

title: Annual safety inspection preparation
description: Pre-inspection check of brakes, governor and emergency stop ahead of the annual certification.

title: Spindle vibration alarm
description: Spindle vibration alarm at speeds above 12000 rpm. Machine restricted to low-speed jobs.

title: Pump bearing noise
description: Grinding noise from the drive-end bearing. Replacing the bearing and checking alignment.

title: Oil separator element change
description: Differential pressure across the separator is above the service limit.

title: Bypass switch failed transfer test
description: Static bypass did not transfer during the monthly test. Control board replaced and retested OK.

title: Condensate drain blocked
description: Drain pan overflowing onto the roof membrane. Drain line cleared and trap flushed.

title: Tool changer calibration
description: Cancelled: covered by the vendor preventive maintenance visit.

title: Car lighting flickering
description: Cancelled: duplicate of an electrical ticket already resolved by facilities.
